charts.title: HD 35843 c: orbits around HD 35843
charts.description: The orbits of HD 35843's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 35843 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Hesse et al. 2025 (2025AJ....170..108H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname HESSE_ET_AL_2025): P 46.9622 d

charts.title: HD 35843 c: its transit
charts.description: HD 35843 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (33, 87, 98) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 7422496, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 12 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 19 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 23-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 12 min late; 23-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 6 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
